notes: All 1625 layout lines read (21 pages incl. references). Branches are overwhelmingly per_study pipeline/model-design choices with named rejections; per_object human choices are limited to by-eye label checks (V19-B06) and a post-hoc explanation of three misclassifications (V19-B16). Per-object fitting is a uniform chain: no per-object model-family choice, no per-object fit rejection, no held-out epoch forecasting. Figure 12 events are not named in the text.
